en: Colorized panoramic view over a historic European city nestled at the foot of forested mountains. In the center stands a large Gothic church with a steep roof (the Black Church) and nearby a clock/bell tower rising over the main square; 19th–early 20th century buildings line a curving street. The top caption reads "Brassó - Kronstadt - Brașov." The reverse is a divided back with printer marks and the date 1913/14.
